fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: A snap from up to 4 tiles away that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Terms Enforced
fusions.desc: Brings the tail down in a ring, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every ally gains 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Counter Clause
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Laminated Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 8% water resistance.
